title: rcaground: Reproducible evaluation of evidence grounding in LLM-generated root cause analysis
description: Reproducible evaluation of evidence grounding in LLM-generated root cause analysis for microservice systems. Provides normalised adapters for public RCA benchmarks (RCAEval, OpenRCA), deterministic evidence ranking, two-stage claim-level faithfulness checking, and a benchmark harness with run manifests and human-rating calibration.
